cards.name: AlignScore

paper.title: AlignScore: Evaluating Factual Consistency with a Unified Alignment Function

official_impl.version: main branch fetched 2026-11-16; no PyPI package

integration.point: add alignment score when judge returns partial/support; local fallback when judge unavailable

gain.baseline: ClaimSupport-CN 100: macro-F1 0.9597 (v10 judge); judge off no_evidence 25
gain.target: partial->no_evidence errors -2 pt; macro-F1 >=0.85 with judge off

validation.command: see docs/research/resource_cards_v2.md S1: manual state_dict load + Inferencer.inference on (claim, evidence) pairs

risks: transformers 4.57 removed AdamW, need transformers.AdamW=torch.optim.AdamW before import
pytorch_lightning 2.6 rejects instance load_from_checkpoint; load state_dict manually
default mode needs en_core_web_sm (not installed); nli head used instead
English-trained; Chinese 0.743 is cross-lingual proxy only

chinese_100.reason: contradict 的平均蕴含分 0.965 与 partial 0.971 同级，高于 support 0.811；中文矛盾被当支持
